inspected_diagnoses.diagnosis: Changed surrounding layout/border context alters Tesseract segmentation/recognition even when glyph pixels match. Partial frame stroke remains on the dark framed example.

Some glyph pixels within the authored text bounding box are removed by masking. Detector expansion does not fully cover this small framed line; PostgreSQL becomes PostareSQL. It remains above the diagnostic threshold, demonstrating why exact identifier preservation must also be inspected.
Goldfish becomes Goldtish after changing surrounding pixels, despite preserved word-region pixels and higher mean confidence. No detector miss of the word; layout/recognition-context regression.

limitations: No broad false-positive or multilingual accuracy claim from the diagnostic controls.
Masking remains experimental: glyph clipping and recognition-context regressions remain.
Six negative photo controls intentionally repeat main-corpus images.
Development controls are not an untouched holdout.
Actual8GB and native Windows/Linux not tested.

cli_wheel.wheel: production-only; detector code and model specification included

validation.recognition: Tesseract only; no GLM or alternate recognizer evaluated
